Class TagInput<T>

java.lang.Object
com.saicone.nbt.io.TagInput<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the tag object implementation.
All Implemented Interfaces:
Closeable, AutoCloseable
public class TagInput<T> extends Object implements Closeable
Tag Output
A tag input provides methods for reading multiples data formats from a delegated DataInput and reconstructing from them data in any tag object type.
